name: branding-nude-neon-cream-violet-cmyk-rgb-colour-blocks
title: Nude, Neon, Cream and Violet Colour Blocks
whatItIs: A light grey page titled Colours Palette with a story paragraph and four large colour blocks in a Swiss-style layout: tall nude, neon lime, cream over violet, with the colour name rotated 90 degrees in each block and CMYK and RGB values in small type below.
whatItMeans: Big flat blocks with rotated names feel confident and editorial, and listing print and screen values shows professional rigour.
techniques: Colour blocks of unequal size as a composition
Colour names rotated 90 degrees inside each block
CMYK and RGB values in tiny monospace-like lists
Main, secondary and tertiary labels above blocks
Neon lime as the loud anchor against neutral blocks

vocabulary.definition: Ranking palette colours as main, secondary and tertiary.
The four-ink colour model used in print.
Text turned 90 degrees inside a block.
